notes.title: A challenging 1.1.0 update is here!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31136587/6a3eebb355b87194c4a4e6567f2e641b41f10c45.png[/img]

Hardcore warriors, just for you - Challenges Mode with 8 brand new, very difficult maps!

For those who want to be appreciated - Achievements for Challenges - of course ;)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31136587/e340a426fd86498e5b39c295638883a8774ae961.jpg[/img]
And for those who want to see their upgrades - In-game Achievements Panel with player's progress.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31136587/c7d48bafb4db944eda9231b567df0311533806be.png[/img]

Here is the list of additional 1.1.0 updates:

- Update Main Scene (VFX, Lights)
- Update Photon to the latest version
- Set save name length limit to 30 characters
- Update videos with units skills
- Added Engagement Screen
- Added new languages: French, Italian, Spanish and German
- Fixed typos in English and Polish
- Fixed minor bugs

Have fun, soldiers!

notes.title: Update to new version! Exorder 1.0.6 is out now!
notes.notes:

SOLDIERS! ADVENTURERS! EXORDERS!

Please stand up for the new update.
[b]Exorder 1.0.6[/b] is out now!

We are pleased to present you the changes:

- New map for 4 players! Huuuray!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31136587/c8c5f0631c4f1e3a9a855faf063bde056bb9c5c8.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31136587/17dfa803f36144966eab8d9289d08912a27eba28.png[/img]

- Balance tweak! Ragebeasts are no longer able to counter-attack. Sorry, Ragebeasts! 

- Graphic tweaks for 7 campaigns.

- Bug fixes of the issues reported by players.

Hope you like the updates? 
Stay tuned for next updates!

notes.title: Skirmish to the Last Living Souls – a new patch and a new map!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31136587/630f5724bc62259d34d0f1335cd206afc26cc7be.jpg[/img]

For the glory of the Cerulean Queen, a new patch has been prepared. It includes [b] a new map - Skirmish07 "Last Living Souls":[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31136587/c2e20765a7f6c87d77c7821e2db8b170cf6f32fa.jpg[/img]

Other changes:
-  We refined the layouts of Skirmish02 "Lakelands", Skirmish04 "Rhinestone Forest" and Skirmish05 "Starshine Temple" maps.
-  We removed 2 vs 2 map Skirmish03 "Damon's Stronghold" from matchmaking. It's only available in custom games.
- We added a warning that the game is being played in offline mode.
- The turns in matchmaking battles have now a 2 minute time limit. Think fast about your next move!
- Steam username is set as a nickname used during battles. You can change it in the settings menu.
- We added a new matchmaking map filter. Two players will never be matched on 4 player maps.
- Bug fixes (mostly achievement related).
- Minor visual improvements.

Enjoy your battles with Exorder!

notes.title: Quick and decisive action - a new patch!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31136587/30f4da37d118f83ea58b83bd89b57066196a675c.png[/img]

Soldiers! Your favorite fantasy war machine just got a little better with a patch.

1. We disabled the V-Sync function that was causing artifacts.
2. We enabled the FPS limit; [i]Exorder[/i] consumes fewer resources now.
3. We also fixed some minor bugs in multiplayer, the campaign, and the achievement system.

We've got [b]great news for Mac users[/b] too - your version of [i]Exorder[/i] is coming soon! Stay tuned!
